subject: Re: Kickoff: factual-recall dissection as a debugging tool
body:
Priya,

Staffing and dependencies.

People: Fumiko 50% leading the reproduction and the science, Yusuf 40% on porting the hook implementations to our internal model stack (the reference hooks assume GPT-2-family module layout, so this is real work, not find-and-replace), Maren 30% on the workbench UX and pipelines, Gustavo 25% on infra.

Compute is genuinely small -- the reference experiments run on a single GPU (V100-class for GPT2-xl), so a handful of Titan A100s covers even the 7B port.

Data: the evaluation prompts and the subject-attribute pairs for the enrichment analysis come from Corpus. We are planning around the Corpus v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10, so the evaluation-data refresh must be ingested before that date. Maren has the refresh scheduled for the week of June 22, comfortably inside.

May 1 reproduction looks safe.

Daniela
